EU VAT/Mwst., plus shipping The end of all days is here: Ragnarøk! Probably the most awaited pedal we ever released! The Ragnarøk is the ultimate culmination of what a distortion pedal can be: it’s a full-blown tube-powered distortion/preamp designed to bring the weight, depth, and organic response of a cranked amplifier straight to your pedalboard. Built for players who demand both brutality and nuance, Ragnarok delivers everything from warm harmonic grit to crushing, high-gain devastation. At its core lies a real tube circuit: pushing air and attitude in a way solid-state pedals simply can’t replicate. Every note breathes, every chord roars, and every pick attack translates with stunning clarity and dynamic response. The Ragnarok is designed to be extremely simple to dial in yet super versatile: you can choose the distortion mode that turns every guitar amp into a fire breather: run it into a clean channel and add a lower gain channel (green) and a face-melting high gain channel to your amp! You can also run the Ragnarøk into an already driven amp as a boost: being tube based the saturation blends beautifully with any existing distortion! When used in Preamp-mode the Ragnarok closely resembles the Lead channels of the Prometheus but with a slightly more american voicing and a plate-driven tone-stack. The Cut control lets you dial in everything from thick sludge to modern metal tones and anything in between while we added a full amp EQ on the inside of the pedal. Just run it into a power amp, cab-sim or your interface for studio- and stage-ready tone that’s fully tube based! While fitted with NOS 6n2P preamp tubes you can swap them for modern ECC83/12ax7’s - just flick the switch on the inside before trying different tubes! The Ragnarok will be delivered with a power supply in North America and the EU. Features: high quality 3pdt footswitches high voltage tube design 2 switchable gain modes (3 & 4 stages) distortion & preamp modes internal amp-style EQ Lichtlaerm-proprietary “cut”-control works as an overdrive, distortion or preamp please keep in mind that all pedals are made to order and may take 14-20 days for production! The Ragnarøk truly hits a perfect sweet spot in their lineup of high gain machinery.
